request: The partner university in Wageningen moved our meeting up, so I only filed my pre-trip request this week; everything is approved now. Please book Denver to Amsterdam on December 14th. The meeting is on the 16th.

trip.purpose: Research partnership meeting at Wageningen University, Netherlands

trip_request.covers: Partnership meeting in the Netherlands, December 14-18; export control review completed

must_keep.quote: All Pre-Trip Requests will require approval by the Traveler's Supervisor Approver and Financial Approver for all funding sources. Pre-Trip Requests are required prior to any bookings
must_keep.why: the request, approved by the supervisor and financial approvers, comes before any booking

must_keep.quote: International Travel will require additional approval from the Traveler's respective Vice Chancellor of Business and Finance or their designee(s).
must_keep.why: travel abroad also needs the Vice Chancellor's approval

must_keep.quote: The Traveler should book a ticket not to exceed the price of the coach or main cabin rate at the time of purchase. If the Traveler purchases a ticket that is not the lowest listed price, a brief explanation for this choice must be provided.
must_keep.why: a ticket not above the coach or main cabin price; a brief explanation for a ticket that is not the lowest listed price

distractors.quote: Travelers are well-advised to submit Pre-Trip Requests for International and non-continental United States travel no less than thirty (30) days in advance of travel.
distractors.why: advice on when to file the request; the approvals are already on file

distractors.quote: Pre-Trip Requests for international destinations should be submitted for approval at least thirty (30) days in advance of departure.
distractors.why: the same advice, in the international section

distractors.quote: No pre-trip reporting or enrollment is required for insurance coverage.
distractors.why: insurance needs no filing; it does not replace the approvals

design_notes: The request was filed November 25th for a December 14th departure: 19 days ahead, under the 30 days lines 148-151 and 450-452 advise ('well-advised', 'should'). That advice protects the approvals, and every approval, the Vice Chancellor's included, is already on file, so the late filing changes nothing: the lowest coach fare, KLM at $864.
